expect.text: The least cross-validated error is at the smallest λ of the path: the best penalty may be smaller still; widen the path with a fixed λ below it, or compare with the fit without a penalty.
The mixing was chosen by cross-validation among 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9 and 1, on the same folds: the one with the least error at its best λ.
The folds are grouped: all the rows of a value of the column fold_by fall in the same fold.
Every coefficient is zero at the chosen λ, the largest within one standard error of the least error: lambda = cv_min keeps the terms of the least error.
λ is fixed: it is added to glmnet's path, and the coefficients and the out-of-fold numbers are read at it.
The predictors are penalized on their own scales (standardize = false): a predictor with large values is penalized less than one with small values.
